entry.title: A City With a Soul
entry.summary: My vision for smart cities: let machines do the work, and give people back what made us human. Beauty, passion, glory, purpose.

entry.title: Measure First, Believe Second
entry.summary: What goes unmeasured gets told however we like. An uncomfortable number beats a beautiful story.

entry.title: Markets Are a Mirror
entry.summary: Every chart is a record of fear and greed. Trading is the best psychology lab I have found.

entry.title: Thinking With Machines
entry.summary: AI should not replace our judgment. It should give us more time to use it.

entry.title: The Other Scene
entry.summary: Freud called the unconscious the other scene. It is where most of our decisions are actually made.

entry.title: 226 Kilometers
entry.summary: An Ironman is 3.8 kilometers swimming, 180 on the bike and 42.2 running, in one day. The body is the easy part.
